video_title: Micah Nori Media Availability | Oct. 8, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on team's disappointment regarding turnovers and offensive rebounds
quotes.excerpt: the reason you're disappointed is because of the things that you've been harping on
quotes.quote: The one thing we talked about today was that you're disappointed. The reason you're disappointed is because of the things that you've been harping on, the things that you know that you place importance on, and they've been the turnovers and the allowing the offensive rebounds. But when you don't do those things in the game, then you're kind of like, so today was the film was ugly, just as ugly as the game.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori says the film session following their recent game was ugly. The team is focusing on the turnovers and offensive rebounds that cost them.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori emphasizes need for ball security and pace control
quotes.excerpt: We just got to take care of the ball, not playing crowds, all those things
quotes.quote: We just got to take care of the ball, not playing crowds, all those things. Got to make sure that we're not playing too fast, play with pace, but just make the simple play. We don't need home runs with this squad. When we're healthy and the way we are right now, we should be able to get good looks without having to take a bunch of chances.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori on the team offensive approach: We do not need home runs with this squad. We should be able to get good looks without having to take a bunch of chances.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori critiques specific turnover play involving Joth and Denny
quotes.excerpt: Joth throws it ahead to Denny, Denny just bobbles it out of bounds
quotes.quote: The ones at the top of the head like we Joth throws it ahead to Denny, Denny just bobbles it out of bounds. We just didn't catch it too well, but I think a lot of it is just playing in rush and some of it is a little bit over-dribbling.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori points to over-dribbling and playing in a rush as the primary causes for recent turnovers.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori explains the process of cleaning up team mistakes
quotes.excerpt: literally pausing it and saying, hey, you tried to force feed this pass here
quotes.quote: Clean up is like just go back through the film, show them the why. So literally pausing it and saying, hey, you tried to force feed this pass here, you have this option here. Clean up our spacing. A lot of our turnovers happened because instead of being where we were supposed to on the perimeter, we were bunched up, which forces a crowd, which is also self-inflicting.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori explains that poor spacing is leading to self-inflicted turnovers as players bunch up and force crowds.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori analyzes the first rotation and defensive lapses
quotes.excerpt: Joth gets stripped on a three-on-one, which led to a bucket for them
quotes.quote: I think that we're up 12 to 4. Joth gets stripped on a three-on-one, which led to a bucket for them. So instead of having a chance to make it a 10-point lead early, it's 12 to 6. And the very next possession, we come down and we lose it in the corner trying to find DC and then they hit a three. So what that tells you is that as quickly as it could have been 17 to 4, it's now 12 to 9.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori breaks down how a few early possessions shifted the momentum against his team, turning a potential 17 to 4 lead into a 12 to 9 game.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori reflects on starters' performance and potential lineup changes
quotes.excerpt: I thought the starters basically just quit at halftime
quotes.quote: I thought the starters basically just quit at halftime. And not saying they just quit, meant they mentally they just were like, you know what, we're done. I should have probably, in hindsight, probably should have just had them be done at the half, that they kind of were. So just pulled them early. They were supposed to play six minutes, but I'm sure much like you guys, and I'm sure much like them, we were all tired of watching it.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori was blunt about his starters performance: I thought the starters basically just quit at halftime. He admitted he should have pulled them earlier because everyone was tired of watching it.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori praises Micah Potter, Sohan, and City for their play
quotes.excerpt: I really liked what Micah Potter, Sohan, those guys, it's City, yeah, they really did a good job
quotes.quote: I really liked what Micah Potter, we talked about it last night, with Micah Potter, Sohan, those guys, it's City, yeah, they really did a good job. And I thought Hansen was good. So as far as rotations go, and then we'll switch it up again on Tuesday, just trying to get the combinations right and seeing how it all flows. And again, that's a good problem to have.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori says he will switch up rotations again on Tuesday to see how different combinations flow, noting that finding the right mix is a good problem to have.
